subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should the remaining fix honor explicit `heartbeat.session` over exec-event forced session keys while preserving today's default Telegram DM `main` sharing, or should this issue also change the DM default isolation policy?
rationale: The source-reproducible heartbeat precedence bug is narrow, but the issue also asks for Telegram DMs to always use per-channel-peer keys, which conflicts with the current documented/default `dmScope: main` compatibility behavior.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Honor configured `heartbeat.session` for exec-event wakes, migrate/restore relevant pending events safely, and keep current DM default behavior unchanged.

options.title: Change DM default isolation too
options.body: Move Telegram/direct-message defaults toward per-channel-peer isolation, accepting a compatibility-sensitive migration and docs/doctor decision.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat entries
options.body: Defer the bug to a larger native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, leaving current explicit-session users exposed longer.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Honor configured `heartbeat.session` for exec-event wakes, migrate/restore relevant pending events safely, and keep current DM default behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core heartbeat/session compatibility and current-main ownership; steipete is the best available routing candidate from the local current-main history despite shallow blame limitations.
